digest.component_or_area: Backend port / reconciler vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (applier, fetcher, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira for scalar concerns (project scoping, env validation, assignee errors), violating backend neutrality.
The Backend Protocol must expose read-only scalar members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exception types to eliminate vendor-specific imports from core reconciler logic.
Full-tree AST inspection is required to catch lazy/nested imports in function bodies, not just module-level imports, to enforce the vendor decoupling gate.

JiraBackend and all Backend implementors must satisfy the widened Protocol by implementing project scoping with DIG default semantics, fail-closed un-defaulted query scoping, and environment readiness checks that raise BackendEnvError.
